card.name: Digits inside number tables and lists
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points or spaces just before the next number in tables, number sequences and dates. The next token is expected to be a digit.

modes.label: Dose and range tables
modes.description: Marks inside rows of numeric values, such as dose ranges and ingredient amounts.

modes.label: Number sequences
modes.description: Spaces or digits within comma-separated lists of numbers.

modes.label: Dates after weekday
modes.description: The space after a weekday and comma, before the day number.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing with number pieces and away from ordinary words, though the listed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up where a number is about to continue, such as in tables, number lists and dates.
